description.value:
Source Monster

Monster: Nerscylla | CR: 6 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

When you hit a creature with this weapon they must make a @Check[constitution|dc:13] saving throw or become @condition[poisoned] until the end of their next turn.

Armor Effect

Trap Master. While you wear this armor, you can set @item[pitfall trap|AGMH]s or @item[shock trap|AGMH]s as a bonus action and you can use an action to cast the @spell[snare|XGE] spell from it. Once used, the snare effect can't be used again until the next dawn.

Tags: mechanic:condition, mechanic:saving-throw, type:offensive, mechanic:bonus-action, mechanic:spell

activation.condition: Armor side active — cast snare (XGE) from this rune

description.chatFlavor: Cast snare (XGE). Can't be used again until the next dawn.
